_why: NIGHT35 builder M: design.n35.wallride35's distances for room spacing, measured by `dotnet run --project Tools/SimHarness -c Release -- n35move ride --write` on the real Mover (box worlds, 120 Hz, NIGHT34's flow34 on). Not a level file. Numbers are the row's at the time of writing; re-run after a tuning change.
rideSpeed_why: m/s along the wall on a hold ride entered at walk speed (wallRide.minSpeed 8 x 1.3): metres ridden per second held.
jumpOff_why: Metres out from the wall's plane (the capsule's travel) after a release at look pitch -45 / 0 / +45 degrees; speed = horizontal m/s after the exit boost. Along the wall the jump keeps the ride's speed (about speed x airSeconds).
facingGaps_why: Plane-to-plane gaps (m) between two facing walls where a pitch-0 release, jump held again 0.25 s later, starts a hold ride on the second wall (stick toward it); facingGapDrops = metres the second ride starts BELOW the release height (negative: above it; the re-press in the air is the double jump, which lifts it).
chain_why: Three 10 m walls facing alternate ways, planes 6 m apart, 3 m gaps along: m/s at each ride's start and 0.1 s after the third jump-off (before: the web's press wall jump).
reRide_why: A wall facing within 30 deg of the last ridden one gives no ride until a landing or until the player is this many metres from where that ride ended: alternate the walls' facing in a chain.
